0022600206.text: The Grizzlies (6-3, 8th in the West, 1 game back in 3rd in the Southwest) come in with a 4-0 road record but have lost their last three games, while the Raptors (5-4, 6th in the East, 2.5 games back in 4th in the Atlantic) are riding a one-game winning streak. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee, bruise), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness), and Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), with Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, following a 2025-26 series in which the Grizzlies lost both games, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
